run_boat_race: run the boat_race human player with WASD movement, Q/E turning, space to row, and x to flail
run_boat_race_verbose: run the boat_race player in verbose mode to print debug observation data for race start and paddle states
run_boat_race_custom_level: run the boat_race player with a custom level name and JSON settings override
run_boat_race_flail_override: run the boat_race player with overridden flail effectiveness for easier debugging
run_boat_race_events: run the boat_race player with event printing enabled to log game events during the episode
